_meta.purpose: Minimal structured DFD (elements + named flows) so per-flow threat generation can anchor to concrete element ids, matching the gold standard's originator_id/interaction fields. Not the general canonical-DFD pivot schema.
_meta.note: control condition: the hand DFD verbatim, no adapter. The model named in the condition key generated the THREATS, not this DFD.

flows.description: parent registration (email, password, name, govt ID, six-digit code) [code: multipart registration payload includes uploaded file field `profileImage`; backend also queries and then writes a `users` record during this registration path.]

enrichment.note: multipart registration payload includes uploaded file field `profileImage`; backend also queries and then writes a `users` record during this registration path.

flows.description: store parent account [code: a new `User` document is written into MongoDB `users` collection during registration, after a prior `findOne` lookup on the same collection.]

enrichment.note: a new `User` document is written into MongoDB `users` collection during registration, after a prior `findOne` lookup on the same collection.

flows.description: child login (parent email, password) [code: child-login request is handled at `/api/auth/login/child` and causes reads from both `users` and `childprofiles`, so the response is derived from a parent account lookup plus associated child-profile records.]

enrichment.note: child-login request is handled at `/api/auth/login/child` and causes reads from both `users` and `childprofiles`, so the response is derived from a parent account lookup plus associated child-profile records.

flows.description: JWT (userType child) + child profiles [code: child-login response is backed by data read from `users` and `childprofiles`; role handling distinguishes child login path from parent-only checks used elsewhere.]

enrichment.note: child-login response is backed by data read from `users` and `childprofiles`; role handling distinguishes child login path from parent-only checks used elsewhere.

flows.description: child profile creation (name, DOB, gender, govt ID) [code: child-profile create/update requests are multipart and can include uploaded file field `idImage`; requests also carry path parameter `:id` on update operations.]

enrichment.note: child-profile create/update requests are multipart and can include uploaded file field `idImage`; requests also carry path parameter `:id` on update operations.

flows.description: store/update child profile [code: child profile records are persisted as `ChildProfile` documents in MongoDB `childprofiles` collection, both on create and update after reading an existing profile for `findOne`-based edits.]

enrichment.note: child profile records are persisted as `ChildProfile` documents in MongoDB `childprofiles` collection, both on create and update after reading an existing profile for `findOne`-based edits.

flows.description: video search, request, like, comment [code: child-facing video interactions include POST `/subprofiles/request-video`, POST `/subprofiles/search-history`, POST `/subprofiles/watch-history`, and video POSTs to `/:id/like` and `/:id/comments`; these operations reference video identifiers via route params (`:id`) and read target `Video` records by `findById`/`findOne`.]

enrichment.note: child-facing video interactions include POST `/subprofiles/request-video`, POST `/subprofiles/search-history`, POST `/subprofiles/watch-history`, and video POSTs to `/:id/like` and `/:id/comments`; these operations reference video identifiers via route params (`:id`) and read target `Video` records by `findById`/`findOne`.

flows.description: store/retrieve video metadata and files (DS3+DS4 combined in source description) [code: video handling writes uploaded file field `video` to backend uploads storage and writes/reads `Video` documents in MongoDB `videos` collection via save/find/findOne/findById/count/aggregate/populate operations.]

enrichment.note: video handling writes uploaded file field `video` to backend uploads storage and writes/reads `Video` documents in MongoDB `videos` collection via save/find/findOne/findById/count/aggregate/populate operations.

flows.description: store child search and watch history [code: child profile history storage is implemented as writes back to `ChildProfile` documents after reading the target profile; the affected history-related endpoints are `/subprofiles/search-history`, `/subprofiles/watch-history`, and parent-side clear operations on `/:id/search-history` and `/:id/watch-history`.]

enrichment.note: child profile history storage is implemented as writes back to `ChildProfile` documents after reading the target profile; the affected history-related endpoints are `/subprofiles/search-history`, `/subprofiles/watch-history`, and parent-side clear operations on `/:id/search-history` and `/:id/watch-history`.

flows.description: video upload, approval/rejection [code: parent video actions include multipart upload with file field `video`, plus approval endpoint carrying both child-profile id and video id path parameters (`/:id/approve-video/:videoId`) and deletion of approved-video entries (`/:id/approved-video/:videoId`).]

enrichment.note: parent video actions include multipart upload with file field `video`, plus approval endpoint carrying both child-profile id and video id path parameters (`/:id/approve-video/:videoId`) and deletion of approved-video entries (`/:id/approved-video/:videoId`).

flows.description: stream approved video to child [code: video delivery to children uses GET `/videos/stream/:filename`; approved-video retrieval for child users separately reads `childprofiles` on `/subprofiles/approved-videos`, tying streaming to child-approved content selection.]
